name: Pipeliners - Fix Log
body:
> Log · Pipeliners · 2026-10-16

# Summary
One row per backup set in `fix-backups\`. Each set holds the before-state (and often after-state) of a live change, taken under the safe live edit recipe. Server-side copies also live in `~/backups/`, `~/otto-backups/` and `wp-content/uploads/pl-backups/`, and most changes have a matching post-meta backup `_pl_backup_<topic>_<date>`. Descriptions are inferred from folder names, file names and the few md/txt files inside (`copy-changes.md`, `RESTORE.md`, `README.txt`). Folder dates follow Kim's Philippine time, so some are one day after the US work date.

# Patterns
- **Sep 22 to Oct 5:** single-page rewrites, schema and og:url fixes, orphan-link work, 24/7 removals.
- **Oct 7 to Oct 10:** Anthem, Apache Junction, Avondale and Scottsdale rebuilds, then the first wave of structure-only restructures (Anthem to Fountain Hills).
- **Oct 13 to Oct 14:** restructure of the remaining city pages (Gilbert to Youngtown), mobile width and Quick Facts fixes, footer containers, liner images, cards and video.
- **Oct 15 to Oct 16:** Mesa fixes, YouTube embeds, Article schema on 31 posts.
